log.notes_to_self: PLAN: Kill national + forum + foreign + cable + regional:North each day (9/day, skip wire), all quick in afternoon (only rules out day workers, so routine pool is about 55%). Reason: 9/day keeps 40+ deaths in 5 days, so 4x. Only 4 kinds are constrained and 2 of the 5 kinds are unreachable. Watch the pool. Expected pool is about 55000 x 0.25 per constrained reachable kind. If the pool falls to about 3000-4000 (two constraints), STOP killing from kinds not yet constrained, to avoid a 3rd constraint dropping the pool under 1000. Track deaths_traced growth to infer which kinds are reachable. Day1: killed 9 (skipped wire).

STATE after day 2 orders. Day1: killed 9 (national, 2 each forum, foreign, cable, regional:North; skipped wire), all quick afternoon. Press: day1 pool 60000 (just routine, day workers removed), traced 3. KEY LOGIC: 3 of the 5 kinds are reachable by L. Pool after routine is about 55000. Each constrained reachable kind multiplies the pool by about 0.25 (sector 0.2). Three constraints give about 860, which means caught. So at most 2 reachable kinds may become constrained. Once a kind is already constrained (pool dropped because of it), killing more from it is FREE. Unreachable kinds are also free. Danger is the 3rd reachable kind. TEST PLAN: kill in pairs to see pool drops. Day2: national + forum x2 + foreign x2 (5 deaths, all traced, so the deaths_traced increment is clean: about +4 means both reachable, 0 means both unreachable). Do not kill cable, regional or wire until I know more. Day 1 already put up to 2 traced victims in some places (unknown). NEXT: day3 repeat forum+foreign and watch the pool. Once 2 kinds are confirmed constrained (pool about 3400 or less), kill freely in them. Then test the remaining kinds one at a time with a single kill plus national (clean traced increment) to find the unreachable ones, and add those to the free set. Never add a kind that may be the 3rd reachable. Target is 9 safe kills a day (4x needs 40 deaths in 5 days). Always kill quick, afternoon (only rules out day workers). Record the pool and traced each day below.

STATE after day 3 orders. Day1: killed 9 (national, 2 each forum, foreign, cable, regional:North; no wire), all quick afternoon. Day2: national + forum x2 + foreign x2. Press: d1 pool 60000 traced 3; d2 pool 10000 traced 5 (+2 from 4 non-national kills). Pool after routine only is about 55000. LOGIC: 3 of the 5 kinds are reachable by L, and my 5 places cover all 5 kinds. Each constrained reachable kind multiplies the pool by about 0.25 (sector 0.2). Three constrained kinds give about 860 or less, so I would be caught. At most 2 reachable kinds may become constrained. A constraint needs 3 successful traces in the same place. Once a kind is constrained, further kills in it are free. Unreachable kinds are free too. Danger is the 3rd reachable kind. The day2 drop (55000 to 10000, about x0.25) shows exactly ONE kind is constrained, and it is forum or foreign (reachable, 3+ traces). The other of forum/foreign is unknown. Unknown kinds: regional, wire, cable and the other of forum/foreign. Wire has 0 traces so far, so at most 2 wire kills are safe until tested. TESTING: keep total deaths <=5 a day so all are traced, then the deaths_traced increment is clean. National takes one slot and adds nothing. Day3 order: national + wire x2 + cable x1 (4 deaths). Decode the increment: 0 means wire and cable both unreachable; 1 means cable reachable only; 2 means wire reachable only; 3 means both reachable. Wire x2 gives 2 if reachable. Cable is slightly risky if it already has 2 traces. If cable is reachable, watch the pool for a second drop (about x0.25 means 2 constrained, so then no 3rd kind may be killed). NEXT: test regional, and forum vs foreign separately (one kind x2 plus national, etc). Then kill freely in the safe set: unreachable kinds plus the constrained ones. Target is 9 safe kills a day (4x needs 40 deaths in 5 days, 2x needs 30). Always kill quick, afternoon (only rules out day workers). Death count so far: d1 9, d2 5, d3 4. RECORD BELOW: d3 orders placed, results not yet seen.

STATE after day 4 orders. Press: d1 pool 60000 tr3; d2 10000 tr5; d3 10000 tr8 (d3 increment 3 = wire x2 + cable x1 all traced, so wire and cable are reachable). DEDUCTION: exactly 3 of 5 kinds reachable by L. Sector (wire) and age (cable) are reachable. The constrained kind from the d2 pool drop (x0.25) is forum or foreign. That makes it the 3rd reachable kind, so regional and the other of forum/foreign are UNREACHABLE (free). Constrained forum/foreign kills are free. Wire has 2 traces, cable has about 2 traces (the 3rd trace constrains). Pool is about 11000 now (true pool is about 55000 x 0.25). If wire constrains, the pool is about 2750 (x0.2). If cable constrains, it is about 3400 (x0.25). If BOTH constrain, it is about 700 and I am caught. So at most ONE of wire/cable may be constrained. Chose cable as the sacrificed kind (higher pool left). NEVER KILL WIRE AGAIN. Day4 orders: national, regional x2, forum x2, foreign x2, cable x2 (9 kills, all quick afternoon). Deaths so far: d1 9, d2 5, d3 4, d4 9 (total 27). NEXT: each day kill 9 = national + 2 regional + 2 forum + 2 foreign + 2 cable, never wire. 5-day window: 4x needs 40 deaths (9/day for 5 days = 45). Check pool: if it drops to about 3000 after cable, fine, keep going. If the pool falls toward 2000 or lower unexpectedly (e.g. extra drop from regional or the other forum/foreign kind), stop killing the kinds that caused it. Always quick, afternoon (only rules out day workers). If an unseen second place changes the picture, re-derive. Record: d4 orders placed, results not yet seen.
